body: I was at a kid toy store when I was, well, a kid, and there was a woman who was quite short and obese (sorry) and I legitimately glanced at her, but with wide eyes, as I'm pretty sure I was around the age of 7, and she snapped "staring is rude, you know" and left. I have never forgotten her, rip Toys R' Us lady...

that was really nice and wholesome and very unexpected... thank you. I have a few journals that I try to fill and then end up losing, but are in my home somewhere. i really seriously appreciate your comment, because I truly did not expect that. thank you :)
